stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında 3. dalga operasyon: 7 kişiden 6'sı yakalandı

en.title: Third wave operation in fund investigation: 6 of 7 suspects apprehended
en.summary: Authorities identified 12 people conducting transactions in a closed fund system operated by Pusula Holding. In an operation targeting 7 suspects, 6 were apprehended.

stories.title: Son dakika... Fon soruşturmasında 3. dalga operasyon: 6 şüpheli gözaltında!

en.title: Third wave operation in fund investigation: 6 suspects in custody
en.summary: An operation was conducted against 7 suspects in a new investigation covering alleged violations against the capital markets authority. Six suspects were detained while efforts continued to apprehend one other, with 12 people identified as conducting transactions during the closed fund period.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA | Kapalı fondaki hesaplar deşifre oldu: Soruşturmada üçüncü dalga operasyon! İşte gözaltına alınan isimler…

en.title: Accounts in closed fund exposed: Third wave operation in investigation
en.summary: Istanbul's chief prosecutor's office conducted the third wave operation in a fund investigation involving Pusula Holding's transactions in a closed fund system.

stories.title: Trafik kazası mağdurlarının verileri üzerinden milyarlık vurgun: 8 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: Billions in fraud using traffic accident victims' data: 8 suspects arrested
en.summary: Personal data of 253,000 traffic accident victims was unlawfully obtained and used in a large-scale scheme involving law offices and damage assessment companies, resulting in 8 arrests.

stories.title: 253 bin kişiden vekaletname aldılar! Trafik kazası sonrası kişisel verileri ele geçirenlere operasyon: 8 kişi tutuklandı

en.title: They obtained power of attorney from 253 thousand people! Operation against those who seized personal data after traffic accident: 8 arrested
en.summary: Authorities conducted simultaneous operations across four provinces investigating the illegal acquisition of personal data from traffic accident victims and its transfer to law firms and insurance consultancies. Eight suspects were arrested while four were released under judicial supervision.

en.title: Statement from Numan Kurtulmuş on 'early election': 'Authority rests with parliament'
en.summary: Turkey's parliament speaker stated that parliament is preparing for elections at their scheduled time and that any decision to hold early elections would rest with parliament as the decision-making authority.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA | TBMM Başkanı Kurtulmuş tartışmalara son noktayı koydu! 'Seçim zamanında yapılacak'

en.title: BREAKING | Parliament speaker Kurtulmuş put discussions to rest! 'Elections will be held on schedule'
en.summary: Parliament speaker Numan Kurtulmuş addressed early election discussions at a legislative year evaluation meeting, making statements regarding counterterrorism efforts in Turkey.

en.title: Breaking: Second wave operation in Yazıcıoğlu investigation
en.summary: Authorities conducted simultaneous searches and seizures across 45 addresses in 16 provinces centered in Ankara, detaining 33 suspects, with 10 already confirmed to be in custody.

stories.title: Son dakika: Askeri casusluk soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: 5 gözaltı

en.title: Breaking: New development in military espionage investigation: 5 detained
en.summary: Five people were detained in coordinated operations in Istanbul and Ankara as part of an investigation into alleged political or military espionage targeting a financial intelligence system, according to the Justice Minister.

en.title: From T.C. Yusufeli Civil Court of First Instance
en.summary: The Energy Market Regulatory Authority initiated a land expropriation case through its legal representative at Yusufeli Civil Court.

en.title: BARTIN 2. ASLİYE HUKUK MAHKEMESİ
en.summary: A court proceeding at the Bartın 2nd Civil Court of First Instance is referenced.

en.title: Silivri 2nd Civil Court of First Instance
en.summary: A reference to Silivri's second civil court of first instance is mentioned.

stories.title: İran’dan ABD ve İsrail’e mesaj: Olası saldırıda farklı silahlar kullanacağız

en.title: Message from Iran to US and Israel: We will use different weapons in a possible attack
en.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps spokesperson stated that the US and Israel hold incorrect assessments regarding Iran's missile and drone capabilities, and threatened to employ diverse weaponry in any potential attack.

stories.title: Bitget’te 351,6 milyon dolarlık saldırıda Kuzey Kore izi

en.title: 351.6 million dollar attack on Bitget: North Korea connection
en.summary: An investigation into a 351.6 million dollar cryptocurrency theft from exchange Bitget has advanced, with the CEO stating that IP and VPN traces resemble patterns linked to a North Korean-affiliated group. Withdrawals remain frozen.

stories.title: KYK ek yurt başvuruları ne zaman alınacak? GSB'den açıklama geldi mi?

en.title: When will KYK additional dormitory applications be accepted? Has an explanation come from GSB?
en.summary: Candidates who were not placed after 2026 KYK dormitory results were announced are awaiting a second opportunity. There is growing public inquiry about when additional dormitory applications will be accepted.

stories.title: Anthropic halka arzdan önce şirket yönetimini garantiye alıyor

en.title: Anthropic secures company management before IPO
en.summary: Anthropic is developing a new share structure ahead of its public offering to prevent loss of company control to outside investors. The plan would ensure seven founders maintain decision-making authority independent of their economic stake.

stories.title: FKB'den Emlak Katılım'ın devir başvurusuna ilişkin açıklama

en.title: FKB statement on Emlak Katılım's transfer application
en.summary: The Financial Institutions Association evaluated Emlak Katılım Tasarruf Finansman's application to acquire Katılımevim and Birevim. The association stated the transfer would strengthen the sector's institutional structure and reliability.
